title: Automate changelog generation and onboarding for seraph-14b-v1
author: Leah Park
description: Context: Onboarding seraph-14b-v1 into the registry requires up-to-date metadata, curated performance profiles and a user-facing changelog entry. Previously changelogs were manually authored which caused drift between metadata, perf results and release notes. This PR (1) adds metadata and perf profiles for seraph-14b-v1, (2) introduces a changelog generation script that consumes metadata + perf-benchmark outputs and renders the release notes template, and (3) wires the generation into the model-registry CI so changelogs are created/validated automatically on model onboarding. Motivation: reduce manual errors, ensure release notes accurately reflect measured perf baselines and quantization/variant notes, and make future onboards fast and auditable.

release_notes:
- Onboarded model: seraph-14b v1.
- Added curated performance profiles for a100 and t4 with baseline latency/throughput numbers and quantization deltas.
- Introduced automated changelog generation: uses model metadata + perf run outputs to produce consistent release notes.
- CI validation added to ensure changelog completeness on model onboarding.
notes_for_ops: The CI workflow adds a new step 'validate-changelog' which must be present on model onboarding runs. Performance baselines for seraph-14b-v1 are included in the perf_profiles.yaml; if perf-bench changes the schema, update scripts/changelog/generate_changelog.py accordingly.
testing_notes: Added unit tests that mock perf outputs to validate templating and required sections. End-to-end CI runs execute the lightweight perf benchmark harness against a synthetic workload to ensure generated numbers are within expected variance.
backcompat_risks: None: this PR only adds new metadata files and a generation script. Existing registry consumers are unaffected. The changelog generation is opt-in via CI and the generated artifacts are stored under releases/changelogs/.
